learnings.question: According to 19th-century psychologist Hermann Ebbinghaus's research on the "forgetting curve," roughly what percentage of newly learned material do people forget within just 24 hours unless they actively force themselves to recall it?
learnings.learning: Hermann Ebbinghaus proved back in the 1880s that we forget about 80% of what we learn within 24 hours unless we actively force ourselves to recall it — simply re-reading material doesn't work as well as being quizzed on it.
learnings.articleTitle: Is Your Brain the Worst Place to Store Ideas? Why I Built a Second One

learnings.question: What is the name of the psychological effect in which the simple act of writing something down (or saving it to your phone) signals to your brain that it's now safe to forget it?
learnings.learning: Psychologists call the habit of outsourcing memory to notes or devices "Cognitive Offloading" — part of what's sometimes dubbed the "Performance Paradox," since the moment we write something down, our brain treats it as permission to delete it.
learnings.articleTitle: Is Your Brain the Worst Place to Store Ideas? Why I Built a Second One

learnings.question: In the Scrum framework, which role is primarily responsible for protecting the team from distractions, helping resolve issues, and facilitating the overall Scrum process?
learnings.learning: The Scrum Master's job is to protect the team from distractions, help resolve issues, and facilitate the Scrum process — notably, "Project Manager" isn't one of Scrum's three defined roles at all.

learnings.question: What is the main purpose of breaking a project into short, iterative cycles called "Sprints" in the Scrum methodology?
options: To eliminate the need for any planning
To increase the overall length of the project
To allow for more flexibility and quicker adjustments
To reduce the number of team members needed
learnings.learning: Scrum is an agile approach that breaks work into short, iterative cycles called Sprints specifically to allow for more flexibility and quicker adjustments, rather than committing to one long, rigid plan.

learnings.question: In the Islamic worldview described in this exploration of life's purpose, what are the three core roles that give human life meaning?
options: Worship, stewardship (khalifah) of the Earth, and accountability in the Hereafter
learnings.learning: This exploration of life's purpose frames human existence around three primary roles: worshiping Allah, serving as stewards (khalifah) of the Earth, and preparing for the Hereafter through a life of conscious choices and accountability.

learnings.question: Which verse of the Quran is cited as stating that Allah created jinn and mankind for no purpose other than to worship Him?
learnings.learning: Quran 51:56 — "I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me" — is presented as the foundational statement of human purpose in Islam.

learnings.question: In Islamic theology, what term describes humanity's role as caretakers or stewards of the Earth, responsible for preserving faith and unity?
learnings.learning: "Khalifah" refers to humanity's role as caretakers of Allah's creation on Earth — a responsibility that extends beyond personal conduct to preserving faith and unity within the community.

learnings.question: In PCIe power management, which state is described as a very light sleep mode, designed for only very short periods of idleness, that lets the link wake up quickly to resume activity?
learnings.learning: L0s is a very light sleep state in PCIe power management — comparable to a computer screen turning off — designed for very short durations of idleness while still allowing a quick return to full activity.
learnings.articleTitle: Power Management States in the context of PCIe

learnings.question: Which PCIe power state is described as almost completely powered down, used for the longest periods of inactivity, and offering the highest power savings at the cost of the longest wake-up time?
learnings.learning: L2 is the deepest PCIe power state — the device is almost completely powered down, giving the highest power savings but the longest delay when waking back up, comparable to a fully shut-down computer.
learnings.articleTitle: Power Management States in the context of PCIe

learnings.question: In Islamic theology, which term refers to Allah's complete and eternal plan for everything that will ever happen, already written and fully known to Him?
learnings.learning: Qadr is everything Allah has planned and written for our lives, encompassing His complete and eternal knowledge of everything that will ever happen — distinct from Qada', which is the actual unfolding of events as they happen.
learnings.articleTitle: The Art of Qada’ and Qadr

learnings.question: According to a hadith narrated by Ubadah bin As-Samit, what happens whenever a Muslim sincerely calls upon Allah with a supplication (dua), so long as it isn't for something sinful or for severing family ties?
options: Allah either grants the request or wards off an equivalent amount of evil from them
Allah always grants the exact request within that person's lifetime
The dua is only accepted if made during the last third of the night
The dua is rejected if the same request is repeated more than three times
learnings.learning: A hadith (Jami at-Tirmidhi 3573) states that there is no Muslim who supplicates to Allah, so long as it isn't for something sinful or for severing family ties, except that Allah either grants it to them or turns away an equivalent amount of evil.
learnings.articleTitle: The Art of Qada’ and Qadr

learnings.question: Given the principle that "Allah does not change the condition of a people until they change what is in themselves," what practical response does this teaching encourage when facing hardship?
options: Take responsibility and make sincere dua while actively working to change your situation
Wait patiently for the situation to change without taking any action
Accept the hardship as fixed and unchangeable fate
Ask a religious scholar to perform the dua on your behalf instead
learnings.learning: The practical takeaway is to take charge of your own condition: make sincere dua and strive for positive change, since Allah does not change a people's condition until they change what is within themselves.
learnings.articleTitle: The Art of Qada’ and Qadr

learnings.question: A data analysis of the full Arabic text of the Quran tested whether the Pareto Principle (80/20 rule) applied to its vocabulary. What percentage of the entire text did the 20 most frequently used words actually account for?
learnings.learning: Testing the Pareto Principle against the Quran's vocabulary found it didn't hold: the top 20 most frequent words accounted for only about 20.83% of the full text, not 80%.
learnings.articleTitle: Top 20 Words to Understand the Quran: A Data Analysis using Python

learnings.question: What term refers to the small diacritical marks placed above or below Arabic letters to indicate which vowel sound to use when pronouncing them?
learnings.learning: Tashkeel are the small markings placed above or below Arabic letters to indicate pronunciation — similar to how vowels work in English — and without them, reading Arabic text correctly becomes much trickier.
learnings.articleTitle: Top 20 Words to Understand the Quran: A Data Analysis using Python

learnings.question: A word-frequency analysis of every verse in the Quran found that one particular verse, used as a refrain, is repeated more often than any other. Which verse topped that list?
options: "Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?"
"Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger."
learnings.learning: Running a value-count on every verse in the Quran's text showed that "Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?" is the most frequently repeated verse of all.
learnings.articleTitle: Top 20 Words to Understand the Quran: A Data Analysis using Python
